messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: DB-CONN-SURGE fired for service=pg-primary-prod — pager fired to primary oncall and db team.

Aisha (oncall): acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it, checking pgbouncer and primary.
Tom H: I'm on standby, can take DB if needed.
pagerduty-bot: Aisha acknowledged the page at 1954321098.
Aisha (oncall): Observing connection_queue > 500, pg_active_connections = 1024 (limit), client errors 502 rising. Rolling window: spike started ~1954320900.
Lina S: Any recent deploys? logs show long-running COPY/large writes?
Raj P: no deploys. Metrics show spike in connection churn from api-hosts in us-west-2.
Aisha (oncall): pulling pgbouncer stats:
```
SHOW POOLS;
db=app_users total_used=380 total_free=0 total_waiting=120
db=cache total_used=40 total_free=2 total_waiting=5
```
Aisha (oncall): pgbouncer max_client_conn=2000, server_conn=100, looks like server_conn/proxy is the bottleneck.
Tom H: quick mitigation options: switch non-critical reads to read-replica pool, and bump pgbouncer pool_size for app_users to 150. Also consider short-term client-side connection reuse.
Aisha (oncall): Trying tenant-level routing -> failover reads to replica for non-critical endpoints. Applying pgbouncer admin change now.
Aisha (oncall): Executed:
```
RELOAD CONFIG; -- pgbouncer
```
pagerduty-bot: escalation to team 'db' at 1954321120.
Raj P: Starting a rolling restart of API gateway instances to trim the storm of new client connections. /runbook db-conn-throttle applied.
Lina S: Can we set a temporary circuit-breaker on the hosted API tier for heavy embedding jobs? That would reduce new sessions quickly.
Aisha (oncall): Pushing emergency edge rule: rate_limit=100r/s per token for suspect routes. Deploying now.
Aisha (oncall): Customer impact update: ~6% of API requests returning 502/timeouts from proxy; top affected customers: alpha-saas, beta-llm. Median gen latency rose to ~800ms.
Tom H: Observability tweak: increase sampling on connection churn traces and enable long-query capture for 5m window. Also enable longer TTL on KV cache to remove frequent DB hits (redwood-optimize quick-win).
Aisha (oncall): If waiters don't go down in 5m we'll prepare a warm-standby failover and route writes to standby as read-only.
incident-bot: Next escalation timer set to 5m.
Raj P: After pgbouncer tuning and gateway restarts, waiters dropped to ~40, active connections down to ~730. Client errors dropped to 2.3%.
Lina S: Nice delta. Please follow up with runbook updates: add connection-usage threshold and auto-tune server_conn for app_users. :memo: 
Aisha (oncall): Creating follow-up ticket INF-2345: db: pgbouncer autoscale + connection guardrails. Assigning to Raj.
Tom H: I'll stay on-call backup; handback to Aisha if stable in 20m.
Aisha (oncall): Will monitor. Handback scheduled in 20m if metrics remain stable. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident manually closed at 1954321399.
Aisha (oncall): Closing thread here — will write full RCA and post to #incidents with timeline and mitigation steps. Thanks all. :heart:
